text:
Rafael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few folks asked for concrete windows for API, Console, and Optimize. Short thread to capture answers + owners.

Aisha: Can we lock the Optimize pilot window? Customers need to plan migrations.

Tom: Optimize pilot -> target: 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-06 (two-week pilot). Beta invite rollout starts 2026-10-20. We'll ship behind feature-flag `optimize.v1`.

Leah: What's the definition of 'pilot' here? production traffic or internal only?

Tom: Pilot = opt-in production traffic for 10 customers, SLOs monitored. Canary at 5% then 25% then full. We'll have automatic rollback on latency/regression thresholds.

Jun: Console changes needed to expose `optimize.v1` and batching slider. ETA for console PR is 2026-09-15. Backend API change `POST /v1/policies/optimize` required.

Aisha: Dependencies for API? Customers need SDK stability.

Tom: API surface is stable. SDKs will add `enableOptimize()` flag in next patch (v1.4.2) — release 2026-09-18. Docs + migration guide will land same day.

Rafael: For Dedicated customers: we will open a private preview starting 2026-10-05. Sales to send invites by 2026-09-28.

Leah: Ops note — what are rollback thresholds?

Tom: Rollback triggers: p95 latency +20% or token error rate >0.5% over 10 mins. We'll use tracing tags `optimize_rollout` to filter traces.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for optimize-service -> 5% (job 4521).

Jun: One more — Console analytics: add cost-per-token view for optimize vs baseline by 2026-10-25.

Aisha: Thanks — can owners confirm final calendar invites and a single tracking GH issue?

Tom: I'll create GH issue and invite owners. PR numbers + rollout checklist will be linked there.

Rafael: Perfect. I'll follow up with an exec note. If no objections let's lock dates end of day.
